name: Oxbow UI
summary: 427 open-source Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js blocks in light and dark mode, MIT licensed.
description: A library of 427 copy-paste UI blocks built with Tailwind CSS and Alpine.js, each with light and dark mode. It covers marketing page sections (heroes, pricing, features, footers, bento grids, testimonials), application UI (navbars, breadcrumbs, command bar, sidebars, tabs, forms, alerts, modals) and eCommerce pages, released under the MIT license.
contains: 427 blocks, light and dark mode, MIT licensed
marketing sections: heroes, pricing, features, footers, bento grids, CTAs, FAQ, stats, team, testimonials, timeline
page sections also cover blog content, blog entries, contact, gallery and newsletter CTA
application UI: navbars, breadcrumbs, command bar, flyout menus, pagination, sidebars, tabs
forms: inputs, input groups, selects, checkboxes, radio groups, textareas, toggles
elements: avatars, badges, buttons, icon buttons, button groups, empty states, tables
eCommerce pages: category previews, product details, product list; copy-paste, CLI or MCP access
